verdict.rationale: DBOS's Conductor control-plane exposes a documented, OpenAPI 3.1-described HTTP API plus a CLI (dbosctl) for scripting workflow/queue/schedule management, and this was independently probed and confirmed working (keyless GET returning schemas). This gives an AI-native user a real documented public API/CLI surface to drive the product beyond just annotations in code. missing for 10: the core workflow-execution surface itself is a code-level library API (decorators) rather than a remote API, and there's no independent hands-on report of a third party building automation against the Conductor API beyond DBOS's own docs and the probe.
